# Emīl Blūm

> Also searchable as: Emil Blum (the ī and ū are Latvian long vowels — both spellings refer to the same person).

> Multidisciplinary designer, creative director, and LLM-assisted coder. Founder of Calumma Studio. Born in Latvia, based in northern Portugal.

Emīl Blūm is a multidisciplinary designer with 15+ years of experience across brand identity, commercial art direction, digital experiences, packaging design, illustration, video production, print, and interactive media.

In 2019 he co-founded Daydream Believers, an award-winning educational organisation recognised among the top 100 education innovators in the world by HundrED, working in partnership with LEGO, Rockstar North, D&AD, and the Ellen MacArthur Foundation.

In 2021 he founded Calumma (https://calumma.design/), a creative studio for rebellious-optimist-led organisations working across education, healthcare, tech, and environmental conservation.

Born in Latvia, became a professional adult in Scotland, and currently raising three children in northern Portugal.

---

## Featured Client Work

Selected projects from 15+ years of client work. Full portfolio at https://emilblum.com/featured

- [Hard Rock Hotel](https://emilblum.com/featured/hard-rock-hotel): A paper vinyl record player, custom-pressed and made from scratch in ten days. Disciplines: Craft, Product Design, Packaging, Experiential.
- [Daydream Believers](https://emilblum.com/featured/daydream-believers): A rebrand built to grow an innovative educational platform from grassroots idea to globally recognised organisation. Disciplines: Brand Identity, Illustration, Web Design, Educational Content.
- [SgMA](https://www.sol-gel.co.uk/): Brand identity for the Sol-Gel Materials Association. NDA — no case study available.
- [Stewart Brewing](https://emilblum.com/featured/stewart-brewing): Beer labels designed from the inside out to present the hidden elements of craft in each brew. Disciplines: Packaging, 3D Visuals, Augmented Reality, Brand Identity.
- [FISGA Spaces](https://emilblum.com/featured/fisga): A modular identity for a Porto creative hub that refuses to stand still. Disciplines: Brand Identity, Web Design, Print, Digital.
- [Unseen](https://emilblum.com/featured/unseen): A social awareness campaign centred on a 360° immersive experience that places the viewer inside the world of a child living with abuse. Disciplines: Campaign, Digital, Interactive, Web Design, Print.
- [National Museum of Scotland — Game Masters](https://emilblum.com/featured/game-masters): A campaign for the first European showing of Game Masters that drew 65,000 visitors — 58% of whom had never attended a special exhibition at the museum before. Disciplines: Campaign, Illustration, Print, Digital.
- [Oxfam — Republic of You](https://emilblum.com/featured/oxfam-republic-of-you): A retro-gaming-inspired political quiz giving anyone a chance to step into the shoes of a national leader. Disciplines: Game Design, Interactive, Illustration, Web Design, Campaign.

## Code & Tools

LLM-assisted coding experiments and interactive tools. Full list at https://emilblum.com/code

- [(Mind)Space](https://x.com/emilblum/status/2057472892699361747): A locally-hosted project management and creative process canvas tool. Includes automatic local server launches, local Whisper speech-to-text integration, and folder-based project discovery.
- [Vault of Vör](https://vor.emilblum.com/): A steganography tool for hiding text and audio messages within images using military-grade encryption.
- [3DGS Forest Bathing](https://forest.emilblum.com/): Experimental website embedding a 3D Gaussian Splat (3DGS) for an immersive forest environment. Desktop only due to file size.
- [Reveil](https://reveil.emilblum.com/): An experimental awareness tool revealing what personal data your device, browser, and computer automatically broadcast. Includes face and audio recognition visualisers.
- [Page Runner](https://page-runner.emilblum.com/): A speed-reading tool based on the Optimal Recognition Point (ORP) concept. Supports .md, .txt, and .docx files. Available in 6 languages.
- [Gradient Tool](https://gradient.emilblum.com/): A simple browser tool for creating and exporting custom CSS gradients.
- [Sound.img](https://sound-img.emilblum.com/): Maps pixel colour values to musical notes for procedural music generation from any image.
- [Window to Nature](https://window.calumma.design/): A Pomodoro-based focus tool with nature scenes as a reminder of the world beyond the screen.

## Art

Personal visual art spanning illustration, digital art, and mixed media.

- [Art Gallery](https://emilblum.com/art): A collection of 30 artworks, viewable as an infinite animated strip or a masonry grid with lightbox.

---

## Interactive Experiences

- [Moments](https://emilblum.com/moments): An infinite Three.js 3D canvas of 64 personal photographs. Drag to explore, works on touch.
- [Swarf](https://emilblum.com/swarf): A viewport-relative canvas of scattered visual fragments — design ephemera, process work, and personal imagery.
- [Play — Ripple Music](https://emilblum.com/play): An interactive audio-visual canvas where cursor movement and touch create musical ripples.
